routing.operation: Receive 42CrMo4 +QT bar, verify EN 10204 3.1 certificate, saw cut blank approx. Ø42 x 188 mm
routing.basis: Material and saw-cut effort scaled from PM-SH-1998 Ø40 x 185 mm and PM-SH-2214 Ø42 x 195 mm; geometry and material are very close.

routing.operation: CNC turning op 1: face, centre drill DIN 332-D M8, rough turn first side, leave grinding allowance on Ø25 bearing seat
routing.basis: Calibrated from PM-SH-1998 and PM-SH-2214, both using two CNC turning operations for similar 42CrMo4 +QT gear shafts with h6 bearing seats.

routing.operation: CNC turning op 2: reverse / between-centres finish turning, finish Ø40 m6 central diameter, shoulders, chamfers, R0.6 max fillets, second centre hole
routing.basis: Turning time set slightly below PM-SH-2214 because target is shorter and Ø40 max versus Ø42, but similar to PM-SH-1998 because IT6 datum-seat layout remains.

routing.operation: Machine M20 x 1.5 external thread on right-end section, assumed 27 mm thread length
routing.basis: Transferred from PM-SH-2214, which has comparable M20 x 1.5 thread; estimate is weakly grounded until drawing confirms exact thread length and relief.

routing.operation: Hob / cut external spline DIN 5480 W30 x 1.5 x 18, length 45 mm
routing.basis: Primary calibration from PM-SH-2214 because spline designation matches exactly; cross-check against PM-SH-1998 W28 x 1.5 x 16.

routing.operation: Mill / slot keyway 12 P9 x 5 and deburr
routing.basis: Based on PM-SH-1998 and PM-SH-2214, both with 12 P9 keyway in same shaft family and material.

routing.operation: Induction harden spline section to 54-58 HRC, case depth 1.5-2.5 mm; include hardness verification sample plan
routing.workcenter: Induction hardening cell / approved heat-treat supplier
routing.basis: Calibrated from PM-SH-1998 heat treatment EUR 7.0 and PM-SH-2214 EUR 7.4; same material, same HRC range, same splined-shaft family.

routing.operation: Post-hardening runout check and straighten if needed before grinding
routing.basis: Added because final 0.02 runout to A-B and localized spline hardening create distortion risk; reference routings do not break this out separately, so grounding is weaker.

routing.operation: Cylindrical grind 2x Ø25 h6 bearing seats to Ra 0.4, controlling runout 0.02 relative to datum A-B
routing.basis: Interpolated between PM-SH-1998 grinding EUR 9.1 and PM-SH-2214 grinding EUR 9.8; same 2x Ø25 h6 ground seats, target length sits between references.

routing.operation: Demagnetize after grinding, clean, protect ground bearing seats
routing.basis: Required by part feature card; included as post-grind handling consistent with grinding cost allocation, but not separately visible in reference routings.

routing.operation: Final inspection and documentation: Ø25 h6, Ø40 m6, spline DIN 5480, keyway P9, M20 thread gauge, runout A-B, Ra 0.4, hardness / case depth records, material cert review
routing.basis: Inspection burden increased versus embedded reference overhead due to explicit runout, surface finish, hardening documentation, and certificate review requirements.

routing.operation: Protective oiling, pack for shipment, release batch documentation
routing.basis: Scaled from overhead and handling in PM-SH-1998 and PM-SH-2214; target complexity is between the two German references.

recommended_plant.why: Use the German shaft line because the closest cost-transferable references PM-SH-1998 and PM-SH-2214 were produced there, including DIN 5480 splines, induction hardening, and 2x Ø25 h6 cylindrical grinding. PM-SH-2214 is especially relevant because it shares the W30 x 1.5 x 18 spline and M20 x 1.5 thread.

critical_ops_notes: Cylindrical grinding is the likely bottleneck and quality gate: 2x Ø25 h6, Ra 0.4, and 0.02 runout to A-B require stable between-centres datum control.

Induction hardening of the spline section may distort the shaft; post-hardening runout check / straightening is included but weakly grounded because references do not expose it as a separate operation.
Spline machining estimate is strong because PM-SH-2214 uses the same DIN 5480 W30 x 1.5 x 18 spline.
Thread operation is only medium confidence until the drawing confirms that the M20 x 1.5 thread occupies the full 27 mm right-end section.
Final inspection should include documented hardness and case-depth evidence for the hardened spline section, not only dimensional checks.
open_questions: Verify the GD&T feature control frame and exact controlled feature against the original drawing before quote release.
Confirm whether the M20 x 1.5 thread length is exactly the 27 mm right-end section.
Confirm whether spline is cut before induction hardening only, with no post-hardening spline grinding or rolling correction required.
Confirm whether 250 pcs and 500 pcs are separate release quantities or price-break quantities; setup absorption improves materially at 500 pcs.
Confirm inspection sampling plan for hardness case depth: destructive section sample per batch or supplier certificate plus spot hardness only.
